title: Metrics for TTI/TTC/clean recovery + regulatory & bank-audit hooks
outcome: Operational, jury-verifiable definitions of TTI, TTC and clean recovery, plus a requirements table mapping regulation/audit expectations to our components
acceptance: Definitions of TTI/TTC/clean recovery grounded in ≥3 sources (e.g. NIST SP 800-61r3, Google SRE/incident metrics, MTTD/MTTR literature), with exact start/stop events and a formula for clean recovery (residual damage + collateral loss)
Requirements table: source clause (EU AI Act Art. 12/14/19/26 with current applicability dates, NIST AI RMF / AI 600-1, ≥1 banking source e.g. PRA SS1/23 or EU DORA) × requirement × our component
All regulatory citations link to official text, not vendor blogs
'Implications for our design' section specifying what the Evaluation harness must measure
